text_blocks.text:
1. A company shall hold its annual general meeting within a period of six months from the date of closing of the financial year.
   — Companies Act 2013, s.96 [350:626]
2. The Registrar may extend the time within which any annual general meeting shall be held by a period not exceeding three months.
   — Companies Act 2013, s.96 [826:1044]
